lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Two harbours, one rock, a sky for sale.|Bring gold. I take no promises.
lines.text: Two harbours, one rock, a sky for sale. Bring gold. I take no promises.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The west harbour is yours, Torvald,|the east is mine. Together we outbid the sun.
lines.text: The west harbour is yours, Torvald, the east is mine. Together we outbid the sun.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I came to keep the Coinwater's peace, Malrik.|Not to buy a dragon like a cart-horse.
lines.text: I came to keep the Coinwater's peace, Malrik. Not to buy a dragon like a cart-horse.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Then keep it with gold, my lord.|Winter is patient. Markets are not.
lines.text: Then keep it with gold, my lord. Winter is patient. Markets are not.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Send the wagons to the harbour. And watch the|shoals. The sun's riders are faster than ice.
lines.text: Send the wagons to the harbour. And watch the shoals. The sun's riders are faster than ice.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The first coin is home.|It smells of fish and diamonds.
lines.text: The first coin is home. It smells of fish and diamonds.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Torvald! You came south for the|sunshine? I'll show you sunshine.
lines.text: Torvald! You came south for the sunshine? I'll show you sunshine.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Vessa. Still never waiting. One day, child,|the road will be longer than you are.
lines.text: Vessa. Still never waiting. One day, child, the road will be longer than you are.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: The rock is held! By the old law,|its master speaks last at the hammer.
lines.text: The rock is held! By the old law, its master speaks last at the hammer.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The first of my brood.|Kesh burns bright, and cheap. Who pays?
lines.text: The first of my brood. Kesh burns bright, and cheap. Who pays?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Fly with us, then. And try not to enjoy it.
lines.text: Fly with us, then. And try not to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Gold from the south. Kesh, burn the north.
lines.text: Gold from the south. Kesh, burn the north.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: The Laurel at noon! By the Truce of the|Stilled Sea: first blood, and no further!
lines.text: The Laurel at noon! By the Truce of the Stilled Sea: first blood, and no further!

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: No crowd worth the name today, Diamond Wall.|Just us, and a great deal of money.
lines.text: No crowd worth the name today, Diamond Wall. Just us, and a great deal of money.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Then let us disappoint the money.
lines.text: Then let us disappoint the money.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Gold cloaks, behind me.|So this is how Aurivane wins now.
lines.text: Gold cloaks, behind me. So this is how Aurivane wins now.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Those aren't mine! Seraphine,|those are NOT mine!
lines.text: Those aren't mine! Seraphine, those are NOT mine!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: That smoke is violet.|Gold cloaks do not bleed violet.
lines.text: That smoke is violet. Gold cloaks do not bleed violet.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Walls don't run, Ice-king. But they|can walk, if you walk beside them.
lines.text: Walls don't run, Ice-king. But they can walk, if you walk beside them.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The harbour, then. I will hold it. It is|the one thing today that hasn't lied to me.
lines.text: The harbour, then. I will hold it. It is the one thing today that hasn't lied to me.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: For the second bid, Torvald.|A gift. Two hundred, in good gold.
lines.text: For the second bid, Torvald. A gift. Two hundred, in good gold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: This coin carries the Outwall's stamp,|Malrik. Dockers' wages. Where did you find it?
lines.text: This coin carries the Outwall's stamp, Malrik. Dockers' wages. Where did you find it?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Lying in the street, Torvald.|Where coin usually lies.
lines.text: Lying in the street, Torvald. Where coin usually lies.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Count it, Ice-king. Count all of it.|Someone is counting you.
lines.text: Count it, Ice-king. Count all of it. Someone is counting you.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Morrow-of-Glass, my daughter.|She remembers both your grandfathers' coin.
lines.text: Morrow-of-Glass, my daughter. She remembers both your grandfathers' coin.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Glass and frost. At least one|of us will match the banners.
lines.text: Glass and frost. At least one of us will match the banners.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Diamonds were never enough|for her. Morrow, fly south.
lines.text: Diamonds were never enough for her. Morrow, fly south.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Torvald. You let me go once, on your wall.|I remember. I will not hold back today.
lines.text: Torvald. You let me go once, on your wall. I remember. I will not hold back today.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Good. Holding back has always|been my fault, not yours.
lines.text: Good. Holding back has always been my fault, not yours.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: And now the old price. Me.|Whoever pays the most, I burn for.
lines.text: And now the old price. Me. Whoever pays the most, I burn for.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I have never owned anything|this old. Except my regrets.
lines.text: I have never owned anything this old. Except my regrets.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Twice each, I said. Let us make it three.
lines.text: Twice each, I said. Let us make it three.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Everything we have, Ysolde! Take that|harbour while the sky is still for sale!
lines.text: Everything we have, Ysolde! Take that harbour while the sky is still for sale!

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Adamarch will remember who stood on the|quay with her. Even if the Archon will not.
lines.text: Adamarch will remember who stood on the quay with her. Even if the Archon will not.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Remember who paid for it, Seraphine.|I would like to know myself.
lines.text: Remember who paid for it, Seraphine. I would like to know myself.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The Laurel was broken by knives. Gold cloaks.|Violet smoke. Somebody lied on my rock.
lines.text: The Laurel was broken by knives. Gold cloaks. Violet smoke. Somebody lied on my rock.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The sky has chosen its master,|and it is not you.
lines.text: The sky has chosen its master, and it is not you.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The harbour is burning, my lord. Adamarch does|not forgive a guest who loses its harbour.
lines.text: The harbour is burning, my lord. Adamarch does not forgive a guest who loses its harbour.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: No... she was the best of us.|Both cities killed her today.
lines.text: No... she was the best of us. Both cities killed her today.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too slow. Again... the ice gives way.
lines.text: Too slow. Again... the ice gives way.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Steel and quilting. Adamarch's coin,|wearing our colours.
lines.text: Steel and quilting. Adamarch's coin, wearing our colours.
